data.define: A short way to say you agree to join.

misuse.text: Don't say 'I'm in' before knowing the price.
misuse.why: It sounds like a firm yes.

publish.title: What does "I'm in" mean?
publish.value: I'm in = Yes, I'll join. Example: "Pizza night? I'm in!" (casual English).
